name: Xinchang

routes.outcome: Official Zhejiang Geographic Information Public Service Platform loaded and exposed portal links for online maps, resources, geocoding, and development documentation.
Current portal JavaScript exposed the division-search route and the area-site listing routes; no parcel-specific route was present in this portal shell.
Public division lookup returned 未授权 (unauthorized). No login, credentials, private token, or workaround was attempted.
Direct native-name division lookup also returned unauthorized; this is a route authorization failure, not evidence of missing Xinchang coverage.
Area-site listing responded, but returned only provincial/general platform entries and no Xinchang cadastral parcel service or anonymous feature endpoint.

Official Xinchang Natural Resources and Planning Bureau organizational document was retrieved. It describes natural-resources/property-rights investigation, cadastral surveying, registration information management, and the Xinchang real-estate registration service center; it is custodian/procedure evidence, not parcel geometry.
The official portal linked this public online-map entry point, but no parcel-specific public API or safe identity/geometry response was obtained in the bounded route inspection.

schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: Not exposed by the tested anonymous routes; WUP point was preserved in latitude/longitude and was not shifted or used to force a parcel hit.
schemaAndCrs.nativeIdentity: No safe native parcel identity was returned. No synthetic identity was created and no GeoJSON sample was retained.

boundedAnonymousResponse.requestScope: portal shell, current JS/config route inspection, two division lookups, and one area-site listing

localCustodianAssessment: The official Xinchang Natural Resources and Planning Bureau document is local-custodian evidence for natural-resources and real-estate-registration work and identifies the Xinchang real-estate registration service center. The reachable map infrastructure is the Zhejiang provincial public platform; no separate Xinchang municipal parcel API was evidenced. General provincial platform prose was not treated as a parcel data release.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only if independently returned by a public route

qualification.reason: Local registration custodian and official provincial map infrastructure were evidenced, but anonymous division access returned 401 and no parcel schema, stable identity, CRS, or geometry was obtained. Adapter qualification remains a separate serial review.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point and latitude/longitude order were preserved.
No coordinate was shifted to force a parcel hit; no exact-point parcel query was available on the tested public routes.
A 401/unauthorized response is a service-access limitation, not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
No full parcel polygon is retained and no sample GeoJSON is created.
The official local document establishes custodian/procedure context but not public parcel coverage or geometry.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, certificate/title, or personal fields were requested or retained.
Raw HTML, JavaScript, PDF, and request captures remain under ignored tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/11928/.
uncertainty: The official provincial portal is reachable and its current JavaScript/configuration was inspected, but the division service is unauthorized anonymously and the area-site listing exposes no Xinchang parcel service. Parcel coverage, update cadence, licensing, native schema/CRS, anonymous geometry access, and runtime adapter behavior remain unverified.
